title: Move Statements to Callers

solutions.title: Two closings, one shared summary
solutions.tradeoff: A third audience needs a third caller written by hand instead of a new branch on one function, and the weight-unit choice - grams for the driver, kilograms for the courier - now lives in two places instead of behind one flag.

reviewFocus: Does the shared function still take a flag to pick which closing to produce, or did the flag actually disappear along with the statements it was guarding?
Is the shared function's new name still true now that it returns a prelude, not a complete note - or did it keep a name that promises more than it does?
Would a third audience (a wholesale pickup held at the dock, say) need to touch the shared function at all, or only add its own caller?
Is totalWeightGrams still one query both callers call, or did the kilogram conversion get re-derived by hand in one of them?

This drill's precondition is that the two callers do NOT agree. Does the walkthrough say what would have to be true for them to belong back in one function - and does it point at drill-08-03 for the contrast?
